rules.description: Store/date-scoped exported prices support historical price review.

provenance.note: Reporting concept only, not an installed report or current setup instruction.

rules.description: Status, currency, unit and product/channel scope affect applicability; exclusions override inclusions.

provenance.note: The exact SYN- export keys and strict matching procedure below are synthetic implementation choices.

rules.description: Concurrency modes, priorities, compounding and rounding configuration can change price results.

provenance.note: These concepts do not mandate the sample algorithm. The price-report enable setting was removed in October 2023.

rules.description: Require all seven distinct mapped export arrays, exact schemas, synthetic identifiers, supported domains, unique keys and complete foreign keys; reject malformed bundles before evaluation.

provenance.note: Strict file contract, fail-first validation and configurable logical filenames are local policy; no filesystem or service resolution.

rules.description: Use supplied 2099 store-local dates and [start,end) for every window; last included audit day must be <= as_of. Register out-of-audit observations separately.

provenance.note: No timezone, DST or current wall-clock inference; invalid windows reject the bundle.

rules.description: Require exactly one base at the exact store/SKU/unit/currency/date. Missing or overlapping bases or multiple active approved exceptions make a row not evaluable with null expected price.

provenance.note: Never choose first, cheapest or zero evidence; retain every conflicting reference ID.

rules.description: Evaluate enabled, date, currency, unit, explicit store/SKU inclusion and overriding exclusion for every promotion and included observation.

provenance.note: Exact export joins; record all failed filters in the documented order, with no wildcard, basket, coupon or loyalty inference.

rules.description: One active approved price exception precedes promotions after the unique-base gate. Otherwise choose only the highest numeric priority among eligible promotions.

provenance.note: No lower-priority stacking. Synthetic approval references never authorize any action.

rules.description: If highest-priority exclusive candidates exist, only those compete for the lowest unrounded result; suppress same-priority best-price and compound rules.

provenance.note: A single exclusive discount wins; exclusive discounts never compound.

rules.description: Otherwise best-price singles compete with one set of all highest-priority compound rules. Subtract summed amounts with floor zero, then multiply all percent factors exactly.

provenance.note: Percent values are integer basis points1..10000; no intermediate rounding, optional compound subsets or extra base candidate.

rules.description: Compare unrounded prices; an exact tie selects the lexicographically smallest sorted promotion-ID tuple and records every tied tuple.

provenance.note: Source-row order never selects a rule or resolves contradictory price evidence.

rules.description: Round the selected expected unit price once to integer minor units using ROUND_HALF_UP; delta=observed-expected; mismatch only when abs(delta)>tolerance_minor.

provenance.note: Rounding and tolerance are explicit mock policy, not universal legal or product-engine rules.

rules.description: Publish complete audit, rule explanations, excluded register, issue queue and reconciled store/currency counts; action_authorized stays false.

provenance.note: Single-unit tax-exclusive observations are not transaction quantities, financial-loss evidence, permission to publish prices or a legal/compliance judgment.

steps.title: Load the named synthetic exports
steps.procedure: Read the bundle's policy and role-to-filename map, preserve the seven independent tables and show actual source counts and the audit interval.

steps.title: Validate schemas and references
steps.procedure: Validate types, exact fields, SYN- IDs,2099 dates, numeric domains, windows, unique keys, supported rules and foreign keys. Reject the entire bundle on the first deterministic validation error.

steps.title: Join exact dated price evidence
steps.procedure: Sort observations and partition the audit period. For each included row, join exact dimensions, record base and approved-exception date matches, and retain all matching IDs rather than choosing ambiguous evidence.

steps.title: Explain every promotion filter
steps.procedure: For every included observation and every promotion sorted by ID, record all failed status/date/currency/unit/include/exclude filters. Exclusion lines override includes.

steps.title: Resolve exception and rule competition
steps.procedure: Quarantine nonunique evidence. Otherwise apply one approved exception or compete only highest-priority rules using exclusive precedence or best-price singles versus the compound set; compare exact unrounded values and document suppressed rules and ties.

steps.title: Round once and compare observed price
steps.procedure: Half-up round only the selected value, compute signed delta and compare absolute delta with tolerance. Keep raw, expected and delta null for not-evaluable observations.

steps.title: Register review issues and exclusions
steps.procedure: Build precise mismatch, missing-base, ambiguous-evidence and out-of-period exceptions with evidence IDs, a human owner and next review action. Preserve excluded observations without a price calculation.

steps.title: Publish the complete review packet
steps.procedure: Emit ordered audit and rule ledgers, excluded register, issue queue, global and store/currency reconciliation counts, policy and action_authorized:false. Report local baseline execution separately from blocked native work.
